activity.notes: After leaving the South African Republic on 11 September 1900, Kruger remained its president in exile but no longer exercised effective territorial rule. ATLAS records this displaced phase as claims_rule through the Peace of Vereeniging on 31 May 1902.

sources.title: Paul Kruger is sworn in as President of the ZAR — South African History Online
sources.citation_text: South African History Online records Paul Kruger's swearing-in as president of the South African Republic on 9 May 1883.

sources.title: Paul Kruger Timeline, 1825–1904 — South African History Online
sources.citation_text: The timeline records Kruger crossing the border at Komatipoort on 11 September 1900 and the end of the South African War with the Peace of Vereeniging on 31 May 1902.
